title: pm-dispatch lanes/spec.md: the closed list of spec edits a product PR may carry names only the error-code ledger, so a liveness-citation row fix (now required on every PR by #31559) reads as forbidden
body:
domain:skills#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw

Filing gate: (b) a follow-up a PR names. The director's contract review of devx PR #31559 (record 6723037686) flagged it for this lane. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

你裁的 #31424 第 2 条（记录 6722023475）列了哪些 `packages/spec` 改动可以随产品 PR 一起改：错误码台账行、平台名注册表、`contracts/`、JSDoc/describe、测试。PR #31552 把这份清单照原样写成了封闭清单（「唯下列搭车改动可随产品 PR」）。devx 的 PR #31559 会让 `check:liveness` 在每个 PR 上必跑。一个产品 PR 把代码从被引用的证据文件里挪走时，CI 会红，必须同时修 `packages/spec/liveness/**` 里那一行引用。这种修改和错误码台账行同类，也不是元数据协议改动，但不在清单里，照字面就成了不许随产品 PR 改。

## Ask

- Decide whether a liveness citation row fix (`packages/spec/liveness/**`) joins rule 2's rider list.
  - The director reads the ruling's sense as covering it ("a ledger row of the same kind and not a metadata-protocol change").
  - But the list is the maintainer's own words. Rule 6 (record 6722123324) says a change to a lane boundary is a decision card first.
- If yes, `lanes/spec.md` L12 (the rider list after #31552) becomes, for example, 「台账行(错误码、liveness 引用)」 at equal line count within the 120-byte cap.

## Serial

- After PR #31552 lands; it is in the merge queue now.
- #31559 makes the gap bite on every PR once it lands.

Related: #31424, PR #31552, PR #31559.
